title: Read a quote
description: Read native instrument prices and available statistics, preserving the source and receipt clocks.

parameters.name: marketId
parameters.description: Exact native market ID; encode the path segment.

notes: Inspect sourceTime, receivedAt and venue availability before acting. The API never switches your chosen market to another venue.
Order-book market readers expose price, markPrice and available statistics. Ostium oracle quotes retain bid, mid, ask, marketOpen and quoteStatus. All values preserve native price units.

title: Read the order book
description: Up to 20 native bid and ask levels for an order-book venue. Oracle markets return their existing unavailable response.

parameters.name: marketId
parameters.description: Exact native market ID.

title: Read recent trades
description: Read the venue-retained public trade tape where available. Trade prices and sizes are decimal strings.

parameters.name: marketId
parameters.description: Exact native market ID.

notes: Oracle venues may provide no public tape. An empty tape is not evidence of zero market volume.

title: Read chart history
description: Get native OHLC history with bounded windows and venue-specific interval support.

parameters.name: marketId
parameters.description: Exact native market ID.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Chart interval, e.g. 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d; supported intervals vary by venue.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum candles, bounded by the venue reader; use 100 for a portable request.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Window start in Unix milliseconds.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Window end in Unix milliseconds.

notes: Candle time is Unix seconds. Request window timestamps use Unix milliseconds.
Oracle candle volume may be null; OHLC and indexed 24h volume have different coverage.

title: Discover venue capabilities
description: Read the venue catalogue and distinguish order-book data from oracle data and configured trading workflows.

title: Read an observed account
description: Public Hyperliquid account observations: main and xyz perpetual pools, spot balances, positions, open orders, fills, funding, order history and portfolio series.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: EVM wallet address to observe; observing a wallet grants no authority.

notes: Not a complete multi-venue balance. Aster private data requires an independently authorized venue account.
Fills and orders are venue-retained windows. Funding is the first page of the recent 30-day window. Inspect coverage.sources for missing reads.

title: Read owned portfolio
description: Read the protected native portfolio for the identity-bound wallet, including the observer’s freshness and coverage holds.

parameters.name: wallet
parameters.description: Lowercase owner EVM wallet address.

notes: The current observer covers approved Hyperliquid USDC pools. It does not convert Aster USDT or claim complete USD equity.

title: Read wallet enrollment
description: Inspect the wallet enrolled to the current independently verified identity.

title: Prepare wallet verification
description: Request the existing owner-bound enrollment challenge.
notes: Complete the exact returned off-chain wallet signature. A challenge creates no trading permission.

title: Verify wallet ownership
description: Submit the owner-bound enrollment proof to the regional wallet service.

title: Save your watchlist
description: Replace your favorites with up to 256 distinct reviewed IDs. Other settings are preserved.
notes: Use reviewed IDs from the dashboard catalogue. The empty example clears the watchlist. PUT replaces the complete list.

title: Update preferences
description: Change supported dashboard preferences. Watched accounts are a maximum of 20 {name,address,venue} entries. Allocation preferences express a target; they do not move funds.

title: Read your profile

title: Update your profile

description: Prepare the exact owner-bound command and return wallet typed data. The leverage, margin mode and exit semantics are bound to the reviewed operation.

quantity.description: Plain decimal string. Never convert money to binary floating point.

maxOpeningQty.description: Plain decimal string. Never convert money to binary floating point.

notes: Market execution uses a bounded IOC price; limit execution uses GTC/ALO/GTX according to venue support.
Cancel uses operation="cancel", marketId, walletAddress, original venueOrderId and an outer intentId; maxOpeningQty="0".
Close/reduce uses the opposite side, reduceOnly=true, a quantity no greater than the observed position, and its current leverage.
Stop loss/take profit use execution.kind="trigger", tpsl="sl" or "tp", triggerPrice, isMarket and a fresh positionSourceHash. GTC and reduceOnly are required.
Leverage is a signed order field; there is no standalone leverage update endpoint. Native support and admission policy decide what can execute.

description: Submit exact wallet-signed consent and fresh risk snapshot IDs. The regional service rechecks ownership, policy, fees, risk, durability and qualification before admission.

execution.description: Native advanced exits require reduceOnly=true, GTC and a fresh original-position binding. Availability is venue-specific.

notes: Sign the exact typedData from preparation using eth_signTypedData_v4. Never send a private key.
Preparation is not a venue order. A receipt is not proof of a fill or settlement.
Retain the original intentId. On timeouts or uncertain execution, query its status; do not automatically submit a new intent.

description: Read durable admission and native-send state for an original intent, including execution uncertainty and replay status.

title: Read funding context
description: Inspect the existing customer-owned funding context and observed eligibility.

description: Read the same opt-in public leaderboard as the dashboard.

description: Check that the edge API is responding. Health does not qualify funded execution.

title: Read service configuration
description: Discover the API version and configured private gateway availability. Configuration does not prove native trading qualification.

title: Inspect capabilities
description: Discover public venues and the platform’s declared trading capabilities before choosing a workflow.

title: List your market keys
description: List the current app account’s read-only market keys, policy, accepted-request usage and account daily allowance. Secret token values are never returned again.

items.description: An IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR. Empty allows any trusted ingress IP.
Exact HTTPS Origin. If set, requests without a matching Origin are refused. This header policy does not attest a server client’s origin.

title: Create a market key
description: Create one of up to ten non-expired read-only market keys. Copy the secret from the one-time response.

items.description: An IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR. Empty allows any trusted ingress IP.
Exact HTTPS Origin. If set, requests without a matching Origin are refused. This header policy does not attest a server client’s origin.

notes: Requires the current app session and same-origin request. Default expiry is 30 days; choose 1–90 days. The 256-bit secret is stored only as a SHA-256 digest.

Per-key minute, UTC-day and lifetime budgets are atomic across clients. An account-wide 20000 requests/day ceiling prevents multiplying the allowance with more keys. Accepted key requests count even if a provider later fails. Denied IP/scope/Origin requests do not count.

IP restrictions use only explicitly trusted Cloudflare ingress. Restricted keys fail closed when trusted client IP is unavailable, including local development. Origin restrictions are an additional header check, not a substitute for IP restrictions or authorization.
A market key can read markets, products and venue discovery. It cannot read private accounts, save watchlists or trade. Public reads remain available without keys under shared ingress limits.

title: Update key restrictions
description: Change the name, enabled state, IP/CIDR allowlist, exact Origin policy or usage limits of your own key. Existing usage is preserved.

parameters.name: keyId
parameters.description: Key UUID owned by the current account.

items.description: An IPv4/IPv6 address or CIDR. Empty allows any trusted ingress IP.
Exact HTTPS Origin. If set, requests without a matching Origin are refused. This header policy does not attest a server client’s origin.

notes: Pause disables requests immediately. Resume retains the original expiry and usage. Lowering a limit below current usage holds requests until its reset or a policy change.
Revocation and expiry remain authoritative on every request; client-side controls are never trusted.

title: Read key activity
description: Read the last 50 key creation, policy change, pause, resume and revocation events owned by the current account.
notes: Does not include secret tokens or token hashes. Use per-key last-used details and counters for request usage.

title: Revoke a market key
description: Revoke a key owned by the current app account.

parameters.name: keyId
parameters.description: Key UUID from GET /keys.

title: Inspect your session
description: Read whether the current app session is authenticated and its public account information. The anonymous response has authenticated=false.
notes: Uses the current app cookie where available. A session is not wallet ownership or trading authority.

title: Request an app identity proof
description: Request the short-lived independently signed app identity proof for a signed-in native Aperi account.
notes: Requires a provisioned app identity signer and a current native Aperi account session. Tokens are credentials: keep them in memory and never log them.
Legacy Cloudflare accounts use the existing POST /auth/identity with no body. Local legacy login retains its identity proof from the verified login exchange.
The regional service must trust this identity issuer. Native app proof trust is currently provisioned for the local workflow; production acceptance must be verified independently.
